title: physaria geyeri
intro: Physaria geyeri, commonly known as Geyer's bladderpod, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in Native American medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Physaria geyeri include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
